english.title: Manufacturer fail to ensure procedure in place ensuring series-produced pyrotechnics (not F1/F2/F3 fireworks) conform
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of pyrotechnic articles other than category F1, F2 or F3 fireworks, namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLES..), manufactured by series production and placed such a pyrotechnic article on the market having failed to ensure that procedures were in place to ensure that any pyrotechnic article so manufactured would be in conformity with Part 2 of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13, 62(1)(h) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a manufacturer of pyrotechnic articles manufactured by series production
placed such an article on the market
having failed to ensure that procedures were in place
to ensure that any pyrotechnic article so manufactured would be in conformity with Part 2

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12249 (CJS code PA15012)

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine
